rulings.restated: Input — The qualified business loss carryforward from line 16 of your 2024 Form 8995 (or the corresponding line of your 2024 Form 8995-A), entered as a positive amount (zero if none)
rulings.model: The restatement covers only the prior-year line 16 carryforward. The instructions also say to 'Include here the qualified portion of trade or business (loss) carryforward allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year.' They add that when 'losses or deductions previously suspended by other Code provisions are allowed in calculating taxable income, the qualified portion ... is treated as a qualified net loss carryforward ... See Line 3,' so those allowed losses also belong on line 3 and the restatement leaves them out.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. Losses or deductions suspended in an earlier year by another provision and allowed this year (i8995 p. 3: 'treated as a qualified net loss carryforward ... See Line 3') are refused through qbi.unsupported ('losses or deductions suspended in an earlier year by another provision and allowed this year'), whose refusal on qbi.eligible reaches Form 8995 line 15 and Form 1040 line 13a (checked: qbi.unsupported true gives f8995.line15 and f1040.line13a refused); so within scope line 3 is the 2024 Form 8995 line 16 carryforward, taken as printed (owner ruling 1a).

rulings.restated: Input — The qualified business loss carryforward from line 16 of your 2024 Form 8995 (or the corresponding line of your 2024 Form 8995-A), entered as a positive amount (zero if none)
rulings.model: The restatement takes only the 2024 Form 8995 line 16 carryforward, so it leaves out previously suspended losses that are now allowed. The line 3 instructions say to include "the qualified portion of trade or business (loss) carryforward allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year," and page 3 says that when losses "previously suspended by other Code provisions are allowed in calculating taxable income, the qualified portion ... is treated as a qualified net loss carryforward ... See Line 3."
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i8995 p. 3, Determining Your Qualified Business Income: "When losses or deductions previously suspended by other Code provisions are allowed in calculating taxable income, the qualified portion of the loss or deduction allowed under each provision is treated as a qualified net loss carryforward from a separate trade or business ... See Line 3"; i8995 p. 4, Line 3: "Include here the qualified portion of trade or business (loss) carryforward allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year". That case is screened: qbi.unsupported asks about "losses or deductions suspended in an earlier year by another provision and allowed this year" and refuses on qbi.eligible ("Forms 8995 / 8995-A business or PTP path"), so on a completed return line 3 is only the prior-year carryforward, which i8995 p. 5, Line 16 describes as "the amount to be carried forward to the next year". Same result as the archived prior ruling, rechecked against the current rendering. Incidental: the line's cite quotes "enter the amount from line 16 of your 2024 Form 8995", which is not in the archived i8995 (see findings.md F2; citation only).

rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Taxable income before QBI exceeds the Form 8995 threshold" = true → f8995a line 39] [helper "Taxable income before QBI exceeds the Form 8995 threshold" = false → f8995 line 15]
rulings.model: The Form 8995 branch matches: line 15 is the 'Qualified business income deduction. Enter the smaller of line 10 or line 14.' But none of the Form 8995-A form or instruction text is provided. Without it, I can't confirm that line 39 ('Add f8995a.line37, f8995a.line38') is the final QBI deduction for a filer with only dividends above the threshold.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. Form 8995-A line 39 is "Total qualified business income deduction. Add lines 37 and 38" (f8995a p. 2), the amount the form carries to Form 1040 line 13a; the dividend-only Form 8995-A path has its own render log (all lines MATCH after the line 33 and 34 rulings). No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Add sd helper "Nonnegative net capital gain for QDCGT" and f1040 line 3a.
rulings.model: The restatement always takes net capital gain from Schedule D and has no refusal for filers without one. The instructions say: 'If you're not required to file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a.' The Schedule D case (smaller of line 15 or 16, adding nothing if zero or less) does match.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. For a Schedule D filer the helper is the smaller of Schedule D lines 15 and 16, floored at zero, plus Form 1040 line 3a, as the instructions say. When Schedule D is not required (i8995 p. 4: "your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a") the Schedule D lines are still computed from line 13 alone, so lines 15 and 16 both equal the box 2a total that line 7a carries, and the helper gives the same amount. No change to the data.
